The duplicate-flagged notes are also referenced as a pull target.","\"Elevated 99215 share appears in every complexity stratum\" is true, but the 0-condition stratum is 10.9% vs 1.8%, so the claim is fine; the 'which is not what a legitimately sicker panel would look like' wording is more assertive than the cautious leaning.","Unmatched numbers 16 and 24 are likely the data 16% and late 24% shares; these are not on the card, and no tool output grounds them, so they cannot be verified.","The summary says \"nearly half\" of 99215s are on 0–1 condition patients (44%); that is acceptable but slightly loose.","Next steps are generic: they cite only two low-complexity claims (C0098732, C0098741) and omit the rationale-recommended C0098853 and C0098944 and the audit trail request; the audit trail request appears only in the rationale, not in next_steps.","The rationale is repetitive and partly redundant (the numeric block and the narrative restate the same facts), and the headline's \"charts match the bill rather than the visit\" is speculative."]}
